summary: Added App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py. It runs a callback (awaiting it if it is a coroutine) in the app's event loop from another thread and blocks until it returns. It raises RuntimeError if called from the app's own thread (would deadlock) or before the app is running. _process_messages records the loop and thread ID; __init__ initializes them. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py. Under the shared venv, pytest cannot run async tests because pytest-asyncio is missing (this also affects existing async tests). I ran the new tests and the two test_call_later tests via a plain asyncio script in /tmp, and all passed. Full suite not run. Nothing committed.
